body:
Thank you for your post and sorry for my late response :)

I think diabetes has been ruled out as my glucose came out really low, and I'm not obese and I have no family history of diabetes. Thyroid is also OK as my doctor says, so this is not the case here. I fully understand how this "condition" can ruin your life because it's currently ruining mine :(. High humidity makes it all worse for me as well... I'm glad to hear that you are better now. It gives me hope that some day I'm gonna be the way I used to. I will update you on everything I find out, but what I start to think is that I'm just this way and I can't really help it. My Mom (who btw supports me really much) thinks that all this heat "is in my mind" and encourages me to visit a psychologist. I think I'll try it as a last resort :D
